reels.title: QUITTING P*RN
reels.caption:
Quitting p*rn? 3 signs it's actually working 🧠

1️⃣ It's midnight, and your phone stays face down.

3️⃣ You slip once, and you don't start over. One slip is −5, not zero.

Which sign are you on? 👇
